intervals.quote: CENNS-10, a 22kg liquid argon calorimeter, has been operating at the SNS since October 2016.

intervals.label: first argon CEvNS observation
intervals.quote: Two independent analyses prefer CEvNS over the background-only null hypothesis with greater than 3-sigma significance.

summary.plain: A 22-kilogram tank of liquid argon that made the first measurement of coherent neutrino scattering off argon nuclei, a step toward the argon detectors used by much larger neutrino and dark-matter experiments.
summary.technical: 22 kg single-phase liquid argon scintillation calorimeter (CENNS-10), operating in Neutrino Alley at the SNS since October 2016; produced the first CEvNS-on-argon measurement (2021, >3-sigma, two independent analyses).
